newsitem.title: EGYPT: Peres to hold talks with Mubarak in Egypt on Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Peres to hold talks with Mubarak in Egypt on Sunday.

text.p: Former Israeli prime minister Shimon Peres will discuss the Middle East peace process with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak in the Sinai resort of Sharm el-Sheikh on Sunday, Egyptian officials said on Saturday.
They said Peres, head of the opposition Labour party, would spend only a few hours in the Egyptian town.

Then Israel's prime minister, Peres visited Sharm el-Sheikh in March when Egypt and the United States co-sponsored an international summit in support of the peace process after a string of suicide bombings killed dozens in Israel.
Peres has since lost in a general election to the rightwing Benjamin Netanayhu.

Egypt, which became the first Arab state to sign a peace treaty with Israel in 1979, has urged Netanyahu to fulfil the peace pledges the Labour party signed with the Palestine Liberation Organisation.
